'''Qohn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nazzar/Legends|Nazzar]] who in [[3963 BBY]] was a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] to the [[Sungrazer cooperative]], an organization that used slaves for deadly risky [[Comet/Legends|comet]] mining. Qohn managed to survive five dives, which was a record as none have survived more. When [[Zayne Carrick]] and [[Jarael]] tried to free the slaves from the ''[[Sungrazer]]'', Qohn was among them, but was caught by a [[Skyreaper drone]] from the [[Gladiator (Crucible)|''Gladiator'']].
